summary: Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, announcing its membership application to the Personal Care Products Council (PCPC), a trade association. This is a routine business development and regulatory compliance step, not a special situation. No financial terms, stakes, prices, or transactions are involved. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, with no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situations event. The announcement supports entry into the Amazon North America marketplace. As a non-US filer, this is equivalent to a routine current report on Form 8-K. No deal mechanics, advisors, or risk-arb angles apply; watch for future marketplace launch updates.
